interpretation.plain_speak: Even among examples with the same static vulnerability rank, the transition into persistent fragility is usually more dangerous than already-established fragility. That means history carries real extra warning information. But the effect is class-specific: OBSERVE is strong, STORE is weaker, and REPORT behaves differently.
interpretation.north_star_question: Moves the native warning signal from correlation toward a usable detector by showing temporal history adds information beyond margin rank, while proving that one universal class-blind rule would be too crude.
interpretation.next_stage: freeze a class-aware rank-plus-temporal detector from phases 17-19 and evaluate its precision, recall, false-warning rate, and lead time on a held-out phase without changing any updates
